email.subject: Stride Co Fitness: quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Ivy,

I was looking at Stride Co's website and noticed a couple of things likely costing you members: there's no way to book a class online, and no click-to-call button on mobile, so people searching for a gym nearby probably just call the next result instead.

I also noticed heavy, slow-loading images, no reviews shown, and a footer with outdated info.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's losing you leads?

Alex
Northlight Web
